instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Write down whether a person agrees, disagrees or partly agrees with something made for them, such as a title, a take, a plan or a file, in their own words", and give it kind (What kind of thing the stand is on (title, voice take, plan, file)); stance (Where the person stands; null takes the stand back); answered_by (Always person: a stand is only ever theirs).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:keep-where-you-stand and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give kind (what the thing is: a title, a take, a plan, a file), the thing (artifact_ref, its identity: 1f: and 64 hex digits, or file: and that identity; or the thing itself: text, contains for a part of a text, or view for any JSON, with fold, how its owner says two texts are the same), stance (agree, disagree or partly, or null to take a stand back), why (the person's own words, kept exactly) and answered_by "person": only send what the person said.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: record:setting (records:read).
